items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 24:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the Gevurot of AB? The aspect of GAR that the Nukva receives from the Ima of the AB of the Mazal, for the building of her Partzuf, is discerned only as the Gevurot of this AB, because these Mochin come only for the completion of the vessels of the Nukva, and nothing remains for the Nukva from it except the NRN within it, namely three ABs of SAG, MAH, and BAN, which are discerned as the aspect of the Gevurot of AB. (Item 104).
